docs.description: Renders a point in time as relative ('2 hours ago'), absolute ('Apr 18, 2026, 14:32'), or combined. Use relative for recent events in activity feeds; absolute for records, logs, and audit trails where exact time matters; combined when both are needed (absolute in tooltip, relative in label). Size sm for dense tables; md for card metadata. Emphasis subtle for secondary metadata. Respect user locale and timezone — never hardcode format.

rules.reason: Bespoke on both platforms: a line of text. Its format changes only the words, which the app formats in the user's locale and timezone (owner decision, 2026-09-24); the component marks them up as a time (<time datetime> on the web) and, for combined, carries the absolute time as a tooltip.
